projects.name: History-consistent belief reconstruction and posterior calibration
projects.initial_intervention: Calibrated risk-stratified sampler on existing legal states
projects.control: Original posterior sampler at equal Stockfish calls
projects.toy_validity_gate: Synthetic exact history posterior; no zero proposal mass
projects.stop_or_falsification: Support missing, low ESS or worse calibration without playing advantage

projects.name: Opponent policy identification and online adaptation
projects.initial_intervention: Shrinkage style-expert mixture with event-level Bayesian update
projects.primary_endpoint: Held-out opponent-action NLL and observable-transition NLL
projects.control: Existing one-ply Stockfish likelihood with uniform floor
projects.toy_validity_gate: Ambiguous hidden actions share one observable event; normalize OTHER probability
projects.stop_or_falsification: No opponent-held-out likelihood gain or online hidden-action leakage

projects.name: Observation-consistent contingent tactical search
projects.initial_intervention: Correct two-ply infoset implementation with policy-consistent action grouping
projects.primary_endpoint: Matched-CPU regret to high-budget observation-consistent policy
projects.toy_validity_gate: Two hidden boards same view force same next action; special move legality
projects.stop_or_falsification: No valid aliasing benefit or depth loss cancels gains

projects.name: Strategic value of information and denial
projects.initial_intervention: Cheap decision-focused VOI/denial estimator at fixed immediate value
projects.primary_endpoint: Incremental instrumental information value on matched actions
projects.control: Entropy and square-count information bonuses; baseline decision value
projects.toy_validity_gate: Revealing irrelevant squares yields near-zero value
projects.stop_or_falsification: Duplicate P3 valuation or only material proxy predicts bonus

projects.name: Calibrated catastrophic risk and material preservation
projects.initial_intervention: Calibrated selective quiet-piece loss model with capture exception
projects.primary_endpoint: Held-out unseen material/king event probability Brier
projects.toy_validity_gate: Quiet exposed piece vs profitable fog capture; no double count
projects.stop_or_falsification: Lower losses without wins, worse calibration, excessive passivity

projects.name: Bounded game-theoretic re-solving
projects.initial_intervention: Tiny deep-leaf restricted zero-sum information-set solver
projects.primary_endpoint: Exploitability/security on exactly solved toy games
projects.control: Existing GT-CFR and deep Stockfish greedy policy
projects.toy_validity_gate: Known equilibrium, counterfactual reach and regret convergence
projects.stop_or_falsification: Toy exploitability incorrect or runtime defeats leaf quality

projects.name: Learned continuation-value correction
projects.initial_intervention: Regularized observation-only residual over Stockfish value
projects.primary_endpoint: Held-out per-game value prediction error on declared target
projects.toy_validity_gate: Future truth feature leakage sentinel; permuted-label negative control
projects.stop_or_falsification: Prediction gain not robust or action gains absent

projects.name: Rational metareasoning under hard clock
projects.primary_endpoint: Holdout decision regret at equal total CPU and chess clock
projects.control: Existing reserve time and fixed root-depth allocations
projects.toy_validity_gate: Near-certain action has low VOC; ambiguous can have positive VOC
projects.stop_or_falsification: Controller overhead, latency or flags erase matched-budget gain

projects.name: Information-state endgame conversion
projects.initial_intervention: Restricted exact belief-state capture reachability policy
projects.primary_endpoint: No false winning certificates on enumerated domain; coverage
projects.control: Baseline Stockfish endgame and known FUN 2026 theorems
projects.toy_validity_gate: Exhaustive witness and adversarial counterstrategy on declared set
projects.stop_or_falsification: False certificate, theorem-rule mismatch or intractable domain
